G0.name: probe: cross-runtime control (STOP file, -nt heartbeat, launcher death), path conversion, empty-cell cost

results.rc_cross_runtime: exit 0-4,64,126-130,137,143,255 exact both directions; child killed by a signal -> rc 0 cross-runtime (128+N same runtime)
results.kill_on_stub: never runs a trap; 5.2->5.3 TERM/KILL = TerminateProcess; 5.3->5.2 TERM ignored, KILL terminates; grandchildren orphaned; stub+wait linger until they exit (10.6 s / 24 s)
results.env_cross_runtime: 9 vars arrive (HOME=child passwd default, MSYSTEM, PATH converted, PWD, SHLVL, SYSTEMDRIVE, SYSTEMROOT, TERM, WINDIR); custom vars, BASH_FUNC_*, TMPDIR, TMP, TEMP, USERPROFILE, ProgramData, COMSPEC, locale lost
results.args_cross_runtime: unconverted; /tmp differs per runtime; /c/... == C:/... in both
results.scrub_builtin: 0 forks; 1.5 ms (5.3) / 4.8 ms (5.2); non-importable BASH_FUNC_a b%% / c/d%% / e=f%% survive and reach children
results.mtime: sub-ms resolution; `: > f` updates mtime even when empty; cross-runtime visible

heartbeat.protocol: hb rewritten every 5 s; watchdog 1 s tick: hb -nt mark -> rewrite mark, else miss++; stale = 30 consecutive misses
heartbeat.load: idle, forkstorm 8+8 and 16+16 in both runtimes

launcher_death_s.parent_taskkill: NOT noticed (launcher survives); with parent watch +0.86 -> all gone +1.06
launcher_death_s.taskkill_tree: segment + forked watchdog killed, cell left detached; with exec`d watchdog noticed +0.7-0.9, group empty +0.8-1.0
launcher_death_s.strays_left: none in any fixed case, both runtimes

cell_overhead_ms.note: suite start-up ~0.8 s dominates; budget 2 s

amendments: 4.1: segment rc trusted only with OUT/seg-N.result; rc 0 without it = CRASH (signal death reads as rc 0)
4.1: launcher never signals a segment and never blocks in wait on it: 1 s nap loop (result file + kill -0 stub, hb every 5th tick), then bounded wait
4.1: spec FILE confirmed; all paths C:/ or /c/; spec carries locale, USERPROFILE, COMSPEC, TZ, PATH tail; segment started via env -i + whitelist
4.1: heartbeat = printf EPOCHREALTIME > hb every 5 s; stale = 30 consecutive 1 s ticks without hb -nt mark (tick count, not clock)
4.1: segment main waits on the cell; watchdog = separate exec`d bash (builtins): STOP/stale -> USR1 to main; main gone (tree kill) -> watchdog stops the cell group, stray check, result=segment-killed
4.1: launcher watches its parent (kill -0 $PPID + saved /proc/$PPID/winpid) and treats loss as TERM; --nohup opt-out to decide in G2
4.2: fork-free scrub recipe (compgen -e / declare -Fx into a file + mapfile); BASH_FUNC gap closed by env -i; no cygpath needed for /c/ paths; locale from the spec
7: ps -W / tasklist fallback measured (210-250 ms) and dropped; new risks: taskkill /T, parent kill, noisy fork counting in the shared 5.2 runtime
